items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who was Mabel Robinson? [INTERVIEWEE] Now, you got me. I (unintelligible).

ctx.x: I'm trying -- so I'm trying to -- we had a lot of --

I tell you, while you're thinking of that, something else I want to ask you. That is -- I guess it must have been in the forties, you were making some records for Decca, and for Vocalion, with Mabel Robinson, Sam Price, with Gene Sedric. When were those records? Were those when you were with Fats?

I don't think so. I don't think so. It's in between, you know, because they had -- when you had those lay-offs, and you got a club date, or record date, I mean where -- whenever, wherever, you appreciated it, and you went the heck on it, and did it. And you got paid, and they don't worry about you anymore, and you don't worry about them. Hey, I'm paid, you happy, good-bye. You know.
